title: Reflective Prompt Optimization of a Deep-Research Agent: A Topic-Disjoint, Multi-Seed Protocol for Measuring Transferable Gains and Prompt-Level Overfitting

rs.innovation_approach: GEPA优化研究agent两systemprompts，用topic-disjoint、多seed和verifier单变量对照分离迁移与验证选择噪声。
rs.key_step: 冻结候选后在新topic与同topic原题复测，并把优化结果统一用canonical verifier重评分。
rs.why_non_obvious: 提示含答案并不证明答案记忆带来验证收益；验证−测试差也不是记忆量的可靠估计。
rs.trigger_condition: When prompt optimization can copy training facts, test topic-disjoint transfer and ablate verifier feedback before attributing gains to memorization.
rs.abstract_strategy: 分离可见泄题内容、实际利用和选择噪声，用独立评测与受控反馈对照。

relevance.how: 24题验证选择噪声不能以gap直接宣称记忆。
可见答案记忆与实际reward利用需干预区别。
